claim.en: If someone touches me in an unsafe way, it is my fault.
claim.hg: Agar koi mujhe unsafe tareeke se touch karta hai, toh galti meri hai.

fact.en: It is never your fault. The person who did the unsafe touch did the wrong thing. It does not matter what you wore, said or did. You can always tell a grown-up you trust.
fact.hg: Yeh kabhi tumhari galti nahi hoti. Galat kaam usne kiya jisne unsafe touch kiya. Tumne kya pehna, kya bola ya kya kiya, isse koi farak nahi padta. Tum hamesha kisi trusted bade ko bata sakte ho.

why.en: Children often feel guilty or fear a scolding, especially when the person who touched them says it was their fault.
why.hg: Bachchon ko aksar guilt feel hota hai ya daant ka darr lagta hai, khaaskar jab woh insaan khud unse bole ki fault unhi ka hai.

claim.en: I am allowed to say NO to a grown-up if their touch feels unsafe.
claim.hg: Agar kisi bade ka touch unsafe lage, toh unhe NO bolne ki mujhe permission hai.

fact.en: True. Respecting elders does not mean letting them touch you in a way that feels unsafe. You can say no, move away and tell a trusted grown-up, even if the person is a relative or a teacher.
fact.hg: Sahi. Bado ki respect karne ka matlab yeh nahi ki woh tumhe aise touch karein jo unsafe lage. Tum no bol sakte ho, wahan se hat sakte ho aur kisi trusted bade ko bata sakte ho, chahe woh insaan rishtedaar ya teacher ho.

why.en: Many children are taught to always obey elders, so saying no to an adult can feel like being naughty or disrespectful.
why.hg: Bahut se bachchon ko sikhaya jaata hai ki bado ki har baat maanni chahiye, isliye kisi bade ko no bolna shararat ya badtameezi jaisa lag sakta hai.

claim.en: Only girls get sexually abused. It doesn't happen to boys.
claim.hg: Sexual abuse sirf ladkiyon ka hota hai. Ladkon ke saath aisa nahi hota.

fact.en: Children of every gender can be sexually abused, and boys are harmed too. Many boys stay silent because they fear being teased or not believed. The POCSO Act protects every child under 18 equally, and Child Helpline 1098 is for all children.
fact.hg: Har gender ke bachchon ka sexual abuse ho sakta hai, aur ladkon ko bhi harm kiya jaata hai. Bahut se ladke is darr se chup rehte hain ki unka mazaak udega ya koi yakeen nahi karega. POCSO Act 18 se kam umar ke har bachche ko equally protect karta hai, aur Child Helpline 1098 sabhi bachchon ke liye hai.

why.en: Safety advice is mostly aimed at girls, and boys are told to be tough, so abuse of boys is rarely talked about.
why.hg: Safety ki zyada-tar advice ladkiyon ko di jaati hai aur ladkon ko bola jaata hai tough bano, isliye ladkon ke abuse par shayad hi kabhi baat hoti hai.

claim.en: If someone didn't scream or fight back, it wasn't really assault.
claim.hg: Agar koi chillaya nahi ya usne fight back nahi kiya, toh woh actually assault nahi tha.

fact.en: Many people freeze, go quiet or comply during an assault because the brain's survival response takes over. That is a recognised reaction to threat, not agreement. Consent has to be a clear, voluntary yes; silence, fear or a lack of resistance is not consent.
fact.hg: Assault ke dauraan bahut se log freeze ho jaate hain, chup ho jaate hain ya comply kar lete hain, kyunki dimaag ka survival response take over kar leta hai. Yeh threat ke saamne ek recognised reaction hai, agreement nahi. Consent ka matlab hai clear aur apni marzi se boli gayi 'haan'; silence, darr ya resist na karna consent nahi hai.

why.en: Films and news reports usually show violent struggles, so people expect every survivor to react in the same way, by shouting or fighting.
why.hg: Filmon aur news mein usually violent struggle dikhaya jaata hai, isliye log expect karte hain ki har survivor ek hi tarah react karega: chillakar ya ladkar.

claim.en: Girls who wear short clothes or stay out late invite harassment.
claim.hg: Jo ladkiyan chhote kapde pehenti hain ya late night bahar rehti hain, woh harassment ko invite karti hain.

fact.en: Harassment is caused by the person who chooses to harass. People are harassed in school uniforms, salwar kameez, burqas and sarees, in daylight and inside homes. Clothes and timings do not create offenders; blaming them moves responsibility from the harasser to the person harmed.
fact.hg: Harassment ki wajah woh insaan hai jo harass karna choose karta hai. Logon ko school uniform, salwar kameez, burqa aur saree mein, din ke ujaale mein aur gharon ke andar bhi harass kiya jaata hai. Kapde aur timing offenders paida nahi karte; in par blame daalne se responsibility harasser se hatkar us par aa jaati hai jise harm hua.

why.en: Families often give this advice out of fear, hoping that rules will keep girls safe, and over time the advice turns into blame.
why.hg: Families aksar darr ki wajah se yeh advice deti hain, is hope mein ki rules ladkiyon ko safe rakhenge, aur dheere-dheere yahi advice blame ban jaati hai.

claim.en: Children are more often sexually abused by someone they know than by a stranger.
claim.hg: Bachchon ka sexual abuse strangers se zyada jaan-pehchaan wale log karte hain.

fact.en: True. In most cases the person is a relative, neighbour, family friend, teacher or someone else the child trusts. That is why body-safety rules focus on behaviour, such as secrecy, unwanted touch and isolation, and not only on avoiding strangers.
fact.hg: Sahi. Zyada-tar cases mein woh insaan koi rishtedaar, padosi, family friend, teacher ya koi aur hota hai jis par bachcha trust karta hai. Isiliye body-safety rules behaviour par focus karte hain, jaise secrecy, unwanted touch aur isolation, sirf strangers se bachne par nahi.

why.en: It is more comfortable to imagine danger as an outsider than to accept that it can come from inside the family or community.
why.hg: Danger ko kisi outsider ke roop mein imagine karna comfortable lagta hai, bajaye yeh accept karne ke ki woh family ya community ke andar se bhi aa sakta hai.

claim.en: Human trafficking always begins with a stranger kidnapping someone.
claim.hg: Human trafficking hamesha kisi stranger ki kidnapping se start hoti hai.

fact.en: Trafficking far more often begins with deception than abduction: a promised job, a marriage proposal, a modelling offer or help with travel, sometimes from an acquaintance or relative. Control then comes through debt, confiscated documents, threats and isolation. Checking offers independently and keeping your own ID are real protections.
fact.hg: Trafficking kidnapping se kahin zyada baar dhoke se start hoti hai: job ka promise, shaadi ka rishta, modelling offer ya travel mein help, kabhi-kabhi kisi jaan-pehchaan wale ya rishtedaar ki taraf se. Phir karz, zabt kiye gaye documents, dhamkiyon aur isolation ke through control kiya jaata hai. Har offer ko khud verify karna aur apna ID apne paas rakhna real protection hai.

why.en: Kidnapping stories are dramatic and memorable, while quiet deception by familiar people rarely makes the headlines, so the more common pattern stays invisible.
why.hg: Kidnapping ki stories dramatic hoti hain aur yaad reh jaati hain, jabki jaan-pehchaan walon ka chupchaap kiya gaya dhoka shayad hi headlines mein aata hai, isliye zyada common pattern invisible reh jaata hai.

claim.en: Getting a girl married early keeps her safe and settled.
claim.hg: Ladki ki shaadi jaldi kar dene se woh safe aur 'settled' ho jaati hai.

fact.en: Early marriage usually does the opposite. Girls married before 18 are more likely to leave school, to become pregnant before their bodies are ready, which is riskier for mother and baby, and to face violence with little power to leave. This is why Indian law sets 18 for women and 21 for men, and why a planned child marriage can be reported on 1098.
fact.hg: Kam umar ki shaadi usually iska ulta karti hai. Jin ladkiyon ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho jaati hai, unke school chhodne, body ke ready hone se pehle pregnant hone (jo maa aur baby dono ke liye zyada risky hai) aur violence face karne ke chances zyada hote hain, aur unke paas nikalne ki power kam hoti hai. Isiliye Indian law women ke liye 18 aur men ke liye 21 ki age set karta hai, aur plan ho rahi child marriage ko 1098 par report kiya ja sakta hai.

why.en: Parents often fear harassment, gossip about a daughter's 'reputation', or rising dowry as she gets older, and marriage can look like protection when money is short and safety feels uncertain.
why.hg: Parents ko aksar harassment ka, beti ki 'reputation' par hone wali gossip ka, ya umar ke saath badhte dahej ka darr hota hai, aur jab paisa kam ho aur mahaul unsafe lage toh shaadi protection jaisi dikhti hai.

claim.en: A child marriage can be stopped by a court before it happens, and cancelled later by the person who was married as a child.
claim.hg: Child marriage ko hone se pehle court rukwa sakti hai, aur baad mein woh insaan use cancel karwa sakta hai jiski shaadi bachpan mein hui thi.

fact.en: True. Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, a court can order that a planned child marriage must not take place, and calling 1098 or the police can set that in motion. If the marriage has already happened, the person who was a child at the time can ask a court to annul it, though only within a time limit after becoming an adult. A lawyer or free legal aid on 15100 can confirm the details.
fact.hg: Sahi. Prohibition of Child Marriage Act ke under court order de sakti hai ki plan ki gayi child marriage na ho, aur 1098 ya police ko call karne se yeh process start ho sakta hai. Agar shaadi ho chuki hai, toh jo insaan us time child tha woh court se use annul karne ki maang kar sakta hai, lekin yeh adult hone ke baad ek time limit ke andar hi ho sakta hai. Details koi lawyer ya 15100 par free legal aid confirm kar sakti hai.

why.en: Once the wedding rituals are over, most people assume nothing can be undone, and families rarely tell a young person that the law gives them a way out.
why.hg: Rasmein poori ho jaane ke baad zyada-tar log maan lete hain ki ab kuch undo nahi ho sakta, aur families shayad hi kabhi kisi young insaan ko batati hain ki law use bahar nikalne ka raasta deta hai.

claim.en: If a man got an erection or ejaculated, he must have wanted it.
claim.hg: Agar kisi man ko erection hua ya ejaculation hua, toh woh zaroor yahi chahta hoga.

fact.en: Erection and ejaculation are reflexes of nerves and blood vessels. They can occur with physical contact, fear or extreme stress, without desire and without consent. The same is true for survivors of every gender, whose bodies may respond physically during an assault. A reflex is not an agreement, and it does not shift responsibility onto the person who was harmed.
fact.hg: Erection aur ejaculation nerves aur blood vessels ke reflexes hain. Yeh physical contact, darr ya extreme stress mein, bina desire aur bina consent ke ho sakte hain. Yahi baat har gender ke survivors par apply hoti hai, jinki body assault ke dauraan physically respond kar sakti hai. Reflex koi agreement nahi hai, aur isse responsibility us insaan par nahi aa jaati jise harm kiya gaya.

why.en: Most people are taught that arousal is always a sign of wanting something, and school biology never explains that the body can react on its own under fear or pressure.
why.hg: Zyada-tar logon ko yahi sikhaya jaata hai ki arousal hamesha chahat ka sign hai, aur school ki biology kabhi nahi batati ki darr ya pressure mein body apne aap react kar sakti hai.

claim.en: If an adult woman has sexual contact with a 16-year-old boy, it is a crime under Indian law.
claim.hg: Agar koi adult woman 16 saal ke ladke ke saath sexual contact karti hai, toh yeh Indian law mein crime hai.

fact.en: True. POCSO treats anyone under 18 as a child and applies whatever the gender of the child or of the adult. A boy's 'agreement' does not make it legal, just as a girl's would not. Adults who know about it are required to report it. The harm is also real: boys abused by women describe the same confusion, shame and difficulty with trust as other survivors.
fact.hg: Sahi. POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai aur child ya adult ka gender chahe jo ho, apply hota hai. Ladke ka 'haan' ise legal nahi banata, bilkul waise hi jaise ladki ka 'haan' nahi banata. Jin adults ko iska pata ho, unke liye ise report karna zaroori hai. Harm bhi real hai: jin ladkon ko women ne abuse kiya, woh bhi waisi hi confusion, sharam aur trust ki problems batate hain jaisi doosre survivors.

why.en: Films and jokes present an older woman's attention as a teenage boy's fantasy, so many people have never thought of it as abuse or imagined that the law covers it.
why.hg: Films aur jokes older woman ki attention ko teenage ladke ki fantasy banakar dikhate hain, isliye bahut se logon ne ise kabhi abuse ke roop mein socha hi nahi, na yeh ki law ise cover karta hai.

claim.en: If you agreed to sex, you agreed to everything that happens during it.
claim.hg: Agar tumne sex ke liye haan kaha, toh us dauraan jo kuch bhi ho us sabke liye haan keh diya.

fact.en: Consent is specific and can be withdrawn at any point. Saying yes to one act, or to sex with a condom, is not a yes to a different act or to sex without protection. A partner who changes the terms without asking, for example by removing a condom, is acting without consent, and the health risks of pregnancy and infection fall on the other person.
fact.hg: Consent specific hoti hai aur kisi bhi point par wapas li ja sakti hai. Ek act ke liye, ya condom ke saath sex ke liye haan kehna, kisi doosre act ya bina protection ke sex ke liye haan nahi hai. Jo partner bina pooche terms badal deta hai, jaise condom hatakar, woh bina consent ke act kar raha hai, aur pregnancy aur infection ka risk doosre insaan par aa jaata hai.

why.en: Films and everyday talk treat sex as a single event that one either agrees to or refuses, and few people are ever taught that consent has conditions and continues throughout.
why.hg: Films aur roz ki baatein sex ko ek single event ki tarah dikhati hain jiske liye ya toh haan hoti hai ya na, aur bahut kam logon ko kabhi sikhaya jaata hai ki consent ki conditions hoti hain aur woh poore time chalti rehti hai.

claim.en: If someone promises marriage, has sex and then backs out, it is always a crime.
claim.hg: Agar koi shaadi ka promise karke sex kare aur phir mukar jaye, toh yeh hamesha crime hai.

fact.en: Partly. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita makes it an offence for a man to obtain sex from a woman by deceit, including a promise of marriage he never meant to keep. But a relationship that ends, or a promise honestly made that later fails, is not automatically a crime; courts look at what was intended at the time. The provision protects women only. This is general information, not legal advice.
fact.hg: Partly sahi. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita mein yeh offence hai ki koi man kisi woman se dhoke se sex haasil kare, jisme shaadi ka aisa promise shaamil hai jise nibhane ka uska intention kabhi tha hi nahi. Lekin jo relationship khatam ho jaye, ya jo promise honestly kiya gaya ho aur baad mein poora na ho paye, woh automatically crime nahi ban jaata; courts dekhti hain ki us time intention kya tha. Yeh provision sirf women ko protect karta hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

why.en: News reports of such cases rarely explain the difference between a promise that was false from the start and a relationship that broke down, so both extremes get repeated as the rule.
why.hg: Aise cases ki news mein shayad hi kabhi explain hota hai ki shuru se jhoothe promise aur toot gaye relationship mein kya farq hai, isliye dono extremes ko hi rule maankar repeat kiya jaata hai.
